description: Generate a minimal es-plus page scaffold (.vue SFC) — plus the SAME `preflight` checklist that generated CRUD pages emit (httpRequest / permission / t / JSX plugin / UI library), with a copy-once app-entry boilerplate (vue3: `app.use(ESPlus, { permission, t, httpRequest })`, vue2: `Vue.use`). Supports vue3 (default) / vue2 / antdv targets. Use this when you need a blank starting template; use `doctor_page` to check an entry the host already has.

features.description: Features to include. Defaults to ['query', 'table']. Options: query, table, dialog

target.description: Target framework: 'vue3' (default, <script setup> + @es-plus/vue3), 'vue2' (defineComponent + setup() + @es-plus/vue2), or 'antdv' (<script setup> + @es-plus/adapter-antdv + Ant Design Vue)

name: scaffold_page
